def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    used=set()
    bars=[]
    for i in range(h):
        j=0
        while j<w:
            v=g[i][j]; s=j
            while j<w and g[i][j]==v: j+=1
            if v!=bg and j-s>=2:
                for c in range(s,j): used.add((i,c)); bars.append((i,s,j))
    dots=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in used]
    bl,br=[b for b in bars if any(b[1]<=d[1]<=b[2] for d in dots)][0]
    bb=next(b for b in bars if b is not bl)
    r0,r1=min(bl[0],bb[0]),max(bl[0],bb[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for (r,c,v) in dots:
        barL=bl[1]; barR=bl[2]; otherL=bb[1]
        o=c-barL
        # own beam cols
        own={c} | ({c+1} if c==barL else ({c-1} if c==barR else set()))
        mcol=otherL+o
        for cc in (own | {mcol}):
            for rr in range(r0,r1+1):
                if (rr,cc) not in used: out[rr][cc]=v
        if (r,c) in {(p[0],p[1]) for p in dots}: out[r][c]=4
    return out

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bars=[]; used=set()
    for i in range(h):
        j=0
        while j<w:
            v=g[i][j]; s=j
            while j<w and g[i][j]==v: j+=1
            if v!=bg and j-s>=2:
                for c in range(s,j): used.add((i,c))
                bars.append((i,s,j))
    dots=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in used]
    src=next(b for b in bars if any(b[1]<=d[1]<=b[2] for d in dots))
    tgt=[b for b in bars if b is not src][0]
    def paint(col, rr0, rr1, v):
        for rr in range(rr0,rr1+1):
            if (rr,col) not in used and out[rr][col]==bg: out[rr][col]=v
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    top=min(src[0],tgt[0]); bot=max(src[0],tgt[0])
    for (r,c,v) in dots:

        mcol=tgt[2]-((src[2])-c)
        paint(c,top+1,r,v)           # own beam: from just below/near bar to dot row
        paint(mcol,0,bot,v)          # far beam: entire span inclusive of both bars
        out[r][c]=4
